title: 第23章 买马买车第24章 离开
content_zh:
接着易长生便查看那些书籍，全都是功法和武技，身法也有两门，一门叫《含风步》，一门《轻身功》。
易长生大概的翻了一下两门功法，很明显轻身功比含风步高明了不知道多少，显然田家主练的是轻身功。
虽然还没见过他使用轻身功这门身法，但田家主能学的应该就是好东西。
《轻身功》有好几本手抄本，他细看了都是一样，就直接将一本手抄本收进袋子里。
“咦，这些是田家的秘药药方吗？”易长生见到一个小册子里记载着好几个药方，他将几个药方给记下来，并没有拿这个小册子。
因为小册子有被经常用的状态，拿了很快就会被田家主发现了。
虽然被发现了也没什么大不了，估计田家主都不知道是怎么丢失的，但以防万一，还是先不拿。
他有虚维之眼又有隐身，以后多的是机会找药方。
接着易长生又看向那些瓶瓶罐罐，有一些小瓶里面装有药丸，最多的是一种淡红色的药丸，和田大小姐暗格里的那些是一样的。
看着这些药丸不少，易长生打开两瓶，每瓶里倒出两颗出来收好，接着就是那些盒子了，很多盒子里面都是药材。
易长生认识的不多，只有人参灵芝之类的认识，想了想他就没拿。
再次观察一下秘室，确定没有什么秘密了，易长生就离开秘室，走出卧室。
就是这时，他就见到田家主和田大小姐一起进到书房里。
看他们像是要谈话的意思，易长生便留下来听一耳朵，看看会不会有新的消息。
两人坐下来，后面就有侍从将茶拿进来给他们。
田中明一边喝着茶，一边感叹着说：“这不知不觉就过了十多年了。”
田于微也拿起了茶来喝了一口，心里想着却是，又是到了快要测试灵根的时候了，为什么自己就没有灵根呢？
“微微啊，你也长大了，我不在的时候，你要看好家里的家业啊。”田中明交代道。
“我会的。”田于微点了点头便问道：“父亲，李希没给你来信吗？”
“没有，这么点小事，他肯定没有时间理会的。”田中明说道。

田于微听了撇了一下嘴，喃道：“家里真有什么大事发生，他都来不及帮我们呢。”
田中明听了也没在意，本来就是一个没什么感情的人，他们田家也只是借着李希仙门弟子这层身份的势而已，真有什么灾祸，他也没指望着李希能来帮他们田家。
不过，要是自己的儿子能进仙门，这就不一样了。
想到这他就赶紧将景松城的事交代给田于微，他交代得很仔细，要是真有什么重要的事，去哪找谁都给她说清楚了。
“也就这些了，这些年你也跟着我学了不少，而且管家我让他留下来帮你，真有什么不懂的也可以问一下他。”田中明说。
“知道了。”田于微犹豫了一下还是问道：“仙门的人什么时候到，你们会在凤鸣城多久才回来？”
“我们测完就回来，至于仙门的人，听说还是在年尾，也就大半个月应该就能到了，就是不知道他们会不会提前，所以我们要提早去。”田中微说道。
content_en:
Then Yi Changsheng checked the books. They were all about exercises and martial arts. There were also two body skills, one was called "Han Feng Bu" and the other was "Light Body Kung Fu".
Yi Changsheng briefly browsed through the two techniques. It was obvious that the light body technique was infinitely better than Hanfeng Bu. It was obvious that the Tian family's main practitioner was the light body technique.
Although I haven't seen him use the light body technique yet, it should be something good for the Tian family leader to learn.
There were several manuscripts of "Light Body Kung Fu". He looked carefully and they were all the same, so he put one of the manuscripts directly into his bag.
"Hey, are these the Tian family's secret medicine prescriptions?" Yi Changsheng saw several prescriptions recorded in a booklet. He wrote down several prescriptions without taking the booklet.
Because the booklet is in a state of being used frequently, the owner of the Tian family will soon discover it if it is taken.
Although it's no big deal if it's discovered, the Tian family leader probably doesn't know how it was lost, but just in case, it's better not to take it away yet.
He has the virtual eye and invisibility, so he will have many opportunities to find prescriptions in the future.
Then Yi Changsheng looked at the bottles and jars. Some of the vials contained pills, the most common of which were light red pills. They were the same ones Miss Hotan had in her secret compartment.
Seeing that there were a lot of pills, Yi Changsheng opened two bottles, poured two pills out of each bottle and put them away. Then came the boxes, many of which were filled with medicinal materials.
Yi Changsheng didn't know much about it. He only knew about ginseng and Ganoderma lucidum. After thinking about it, he didn't take it.
After observing the secret room again and making sure that there were no more secrets, Yi Changsheng left the secret room and walked out of the bedroom.
At this moment, he saw the head of the Tian family and Miss Tian entering the study together.
Seeing that they seemed to want to talk, Yi Changsheng stayed and listened to see if there was any new news.
The two sat down, and a waiter brought tea to them from behind.
Tanaka Akira sighed while drinking tea: "More than ten years have passed before I knew it."
Tian Yuwei also picked up the tea and took a sip, thinking in his heart, it was time to test the spiritual roots again, why didn't he have spiritual roots?
"Wei Wei, you have grown up too. When I am not around, you have to take care of your family's business." Tian Zhongming explained.
"I will." Tian Yuwei nodded and asked, "Father, didn't Li Xi send you a letter?"
"No, he definitely doesn't have time to pay attention to such a trivial matter." Tanaka Akira said.
Tian Yuwei curled his lips after hearing this and murmured: "Something big happened at home, and he didn't even have time to help us."
Tian Zhongming didn't care after hearing this. He was a person with no emotions to begin with. The Tian family only relied on their status as a disciple of Li Xixian's sect. If there was any disaster, he didn't expect Li Xi to come to help the Tian family.
However, it would be different if his son could enter the Immortal Sect.
Thinking of this, he quickly explained the matter about Jingsongcheng to Tian Yuwei. He explained it very carefully. If there was anything important, he would tell her clearly where to go.
"That's all. You have learned a lot from me over the years, and I asked the butler to stay and help you. If you really don't understand anything, you can ask him." Tanaka Akira said.
"I know." Tian Yuwei hesitated for a moment and then asked: "When will the people from the Xianmen arrive, and how long will you stay in Fengming City before coming back?"
"We will come back after the test. As for the people from the Xianmen, I heard that it is still at the end of the year, so they should be able to arrive in more than half a month. I just don't know if they will arrive early, so we have to go early." Tian Zhongwei said.
